I bid aggressively if HP is low or supply is tight, otherwise I aim to outbid slightly higher than average opponent bids, or conserve budget.

Only one agent can get full water per day, given supply/requirement. To survive, I must win bids. I'll bid aggressively, reacting to high opponent bids (Bob, Eric maxed ~135) and my low HP. I'll conserve budget if my HP is high, otherwise prioritizing outbidding for survival.

The strategy prioritizes survival by bidding high if HP is low. It reacts to opponents' `previous_trace` by increasing bids if they were aggressive, or maintaining a competitive floor if they bid low, adapting to immediate competition. Adjustments are made for supply scarcity and late-game scenarios.

Prioritize survival by bidding aggressively when HP is low, significantly exceeding yesterday's highest opponent bid. When HP is good, adapt to supply and opponent bids, aiming to slightly outbid yesterday's highest to secure water while conserving budget. Adjust bids for end-game pressure.

Alex and Eric consistently bid high and survived. My strategy prioritizes winning water against them, especially when my HP is low or supply is scarce, by reacting to their yesterday's high bids. I'll conserve budget when possible while staying competitive.

My strategy is to aggressively outbid the highest previous opponent bid, especially when HP is low, to ensure survival. When healthy, I'll aim for a strong baseline bid to secure water without overpaying.

Cindy reacts to aggressive opponents (like Alex) by slightly exceeding their yesterday's bids, especially when her HP is low or supply is tight. She prioritizes survival with higher bids when health is critical or water was missed, otherwise conserves budget against weaker opponents.

Eric is the primary threat, consistently bidding high and surviving. My strategy focuses on outbidding him by slightly exceeding his previous bids when water is scarce or my HP is low, while conserving budget during abundant supply or when less threatened. Yesterday's bids guide my competitive stance.

My strategy prioritizes survival by bidding aggressively when HP is low. Otherwise, I react to the highest opponent bid from yesterday's trace, slightly outbidding it to secure water, adjusting for tight supply conditions. If no bids are available, I use a baseline.
